note: Each value in `metrics` is the median of 50 `overhead-<sha>` CI artifacts captured between 2026-08-04 and 2026-10-02, after the reference-loop sampling fix. Five more runs were excluded because a wall-clock measurement drifted by more than 1.10 within the run. `spread` records how each metric varied across those runs, as multiples of its median: `max_over_median` is the worst run observed and `mean_3sd_over_median` is mean plus three standard deviations. The regression tolerance in conftest.py must cover both for every gated metric, and test_baseline_ratchet.py enforces that. The two reference-loop ratios are recorded in `spread` but deliberately left out of `metrics`, which keeps them informational. Their spread comes mostly from runner hardware rather than noise: a fast runner shrinks the torch workload more than the SDK's Python overhead, so the same code measures about 1.45x higher there. Only CI-runner numbers belong in this file. Regenerate procedure: tests/overhead/README.md.
